paite: "Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen; Pathian na gingta ua, kei leng hon gingta sam un.
heading: Pa Kiang Zotna Lampi

paite: Ka Pa inn ah tenna mun tampi a-om; a-om lou hileh, ka hon hilhta ding hi; noute a dia mun bawl ding a kuan dek ka hi.
Huan nou a dia mun bawl ding a ka kuanleh ka hong kik nawn ding a, ka kiang ah nou ka hon la ding, ka omna a nou leng na om theih samna ding un.
Ka hohna ding alampi na thei uh," achi hi.
Thomas in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia ka thei kei uh, alampi bang ka chi theih ding ua?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Keimah tuh huai lampi, huai thutak leh huai hinna ka hi; keimah a pai lou kuamah Pa kiang atung kei," achi hi.
"Kei na hon theih khit uleh ka Pa leng na thei khinta ding uh; tu a kipan amah na thei ua muh leng na muta uhi," achi hi.
Philip in akiang ah, "Toupa, huai Pa kou hon ensak in, huchi in kou a ding in ahun ding,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip, hiai tanpi na kiang ah ka om a, huchi a leng hon thei lou maw? Kuapeuh kei hon mu tuh Pa mu ahi. Huai Pa kou hon musak in bangchi chih a na chih ahia?
Kei Pa ah ka om a, keimah ah Pa a-om chih na gingta kei a hia? Na kiang ua thu ka gen, keimah phuahtawm in ka gen kei; keimah ah Pa a-om gige a, thil ahih zaw nak hi.
Kei Pa a ka omleh Pa keimah a a-om gingta un; ahihkeileh thilhih ziak bek in hon gingta un.
Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh hon gingta in ka thilhihte ahih sam ding; hiai sang a thupizaw leng ahih ding, Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in.
Huan ka min a na nget peuhmah uh ka hih zel ding, Tapa a Pa pahtawi a a-omtheihna ding in.
Nou ka min a bangpeuh na hon nget uleh, ka hih zel ding hi," achi hi.
"Nou na hon it uleh, ka thupiakte na zui ding uhi.
heading: Kha Siangthou Chiamna

paite: Huan Pa ka ngen dia, ama'n Khamuanpa dang ahon pe ding, tangtawn a na kiang ua om ding in;
huai thutak Kha; khovel in aneih theih louh ahi, amah amuh louh a, atheih louh behlap ziak in; nou amah na thei ua, na kiang uah a-om gige ngal a, noumau sung ah a-om ding hi.
"Tagah ding in ka hon paisan kei ding; na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding hi.
Sawt louchik sung khovel in ahon mu nawn kei ding; himahleh nou zaw na hon mu ding uh; keimah ka hin ziak in nou leng na hing sam ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in kei ka Pa a ka om leh nou keimah a na om bang un, kei noumau a ka omdan na thei ding uhi.
"Kuapeuh ka thupiakte nei a, zui tuh kei hon it ahi; kuapeuh kei hon it ka Pa'n a-it ding, ke'n leng amah ka it ding a, akiang ah ka hihna ka kilak ding," achi hi.
Huan Judas, Iskariot lou pen in akiang ah, "Toupa, koute kiang a na kilak a, khovel kiang a na kilak louh se ding bangziak ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Mi'n ahon itleh ka thute azui ding a; ka Pa'n amah a-it dia, akiang ah ka hong pai ding ua, amah toh ka tengkhawm gige ding uhi.
Kuapeuh hon itlou in ka thu azui kei; na thuzakte uh kei a ahi kei a, Pa hon sawlpa a ahi zaw.
"Na kiang ua ka om takdih sung in, hiai thute ka hon hilh ahi.
Khamuanpa, Kha Siangthou, Pa in ka min a hon sawl ding in bangkim nou ahon sinsak ding a, na kiang ua ka gen tengteng nou ahon theikhesak nawn lai ding.
"Khamuanna ka hon nutsiat hi; keimah khamuanna ka hon pia; khovel in apiak bang in ka hon pe kei. Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen, lauh leng lau kei hen.
Ka paimang ding a, na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding, ka hon chih omdan na theita uh. Nou na hon it uh leh Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in na kipak ding uh ahi; keimah sang in Pa athupizaw ngal a.
Tu in hiai thil ahong tun chiang a na gintak theihna ding un ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi.
Na kiang uah thu ka gen tam nawn kei ding, khovel vaihawmpa ahong pai dek ziak in; ama'n keimah ah bangmah anei kei hi.
Himahleh ke'n Pa ka it chih leh Pa in hon thupiak bang zel in thil ka hih chih, khovel in atheihna ding uh ahi ve. Dingh dih ua, hiai a kipan i paikhe ding uh.
